name: arrows-vertical-circle
description: A vertical double-headed resize arrow inside a circle.
useCase: Indicate resizing along the vertical axis.
misuse: Pair this symbol with a clear label when its meaning depends on context.

16.reason: The complete double-headed arrow keeps at least one pixel of clear space from its enclosing frame.

24.reason: The complete double-headed arrow keeps at least 1.5 pixels of clear space from its enclosing frame.
